recipe.visualDefinition: A high-glamour female subject centered in a retro diner booth, surrounded by an excessive spread of Southern comfort food. The scene blends high-fashion elements like gold velvet and ostrich feathers with the gritty, saturated environment of a classic American eatery, utilizing harsh flash to create a cinematic, slightly surreal atmosphere.
coreVisualRelationships: High-fashion gold textures against multi-colored patterned upholstery
Symmetrical floral arrangements framing the subject's head
Chaotic foreground of white plates contrasting with the dark, speckled tabletop
Warm skin tones and gold fabric popping against cool blue-grey table surfaces
coreInvariants: High-key flash photography with hard shadows
Abundance of Southern food items (wings, mash, iced tea)
Subject in a high-bun hairstyle with dramatic makeup
Gold velvet gown draped beneath the table line

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered vertically and horizontally, occupying the middle third of the frame in a medium-full shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the silver shaker held aloft create the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's face, moves down to the expansive food spread, follows the curve of the table, and settles on the gold fabric at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is packed with detail, using the dark background windows to provide small areas of rest.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm gold and ochre (gown, food, lighting)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant reds and oranges (iced tea, hot sauce, flowers, upholstery pattern)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds and golds; high value contrast between the white plates and the dark booth.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of a bold, high-contrast serif and a fluid, elegant script.
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses thick vertical stems and thin horizontal hairlines (Didone style)
Secondary text uses a connected, slanted cursive with decorative flourishes
White color for all text to ensure legibility against dark backgrounds
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended swashes on the capital letters of the script font
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a rigid, authoritative serif and a personal, decorative script.
graphicDevices: Corner placement to frame the central subject

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the high-fashion, high-contrast serif look.
Matches the elegant, formal cursive aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic photo of a woman in a gold sequined corset and ostrich feather sleeves sitting in a retro diner booth. The table is overflowing with plates of fried chicken, mashed potatoes, and red iced tea. Use harsh flash lighting. The booth has colorful 90s patterned upholstery and yellow flowers in the background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold white all-caps serif text in the bottom left corner and elegant white script text in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting harsh with visible shadows?
Is the food spread dense and varied?
Are the two fonts distinct in style (serif vs script)?
Is the gold velvet fabric visible at the bottom?

mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on condiment bottles

mustAchieve: Rich gold and red color palette

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the subject's expression is bold and playful
Check that the white plates don't blow out too much from the flash
Verify the text is placed in the lower corners only
Confirm the presence of the gold velvet gown under the table
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [High Fashion Garment] + [Low-Brow Setting] + [Maximalist Prop Spread] + [Harsh Flash Photography] + [Didone/Script Typographic Pairing].
